items.title: 霧の波止場
items.artist: 黒木譲とナイト・シャドウズ
items.caption: 1960s Japanese mood kayo ballad, slow and smoky, film noir atmosphere. A deep, velvety male baritone crooner singing in Japanese with a slow vibrato, restrained and world-weary. A breathy tenor saxophone answering every line, tremolo electric guitar, soft brushed drums, upright bass, a quiet string section and vibraphone. Lonely, fatalistic, a man in a raincoat waiting on a foggy wharf at night. Warm vintage mono-era studio sound with plate reverb.
items.lyrics:
[Intro - Saxophone]

[Verse 1]
霧にけむる 波止場の灯り
汽笛がひとつ 夜を裂く
コートの襟を 立てたまま
お前の影を 探してる

[Chorus]
ああ 霧の波止場
帰らぬ船を 待つ男
煙草の火だけが 赤く燃えて
未練をそっと 照らしてる

[Verse 2]
あの夜お前は 何も言わず
小さな鞄を ひとつ提げ
振り向きもせず 桟橋を
ヒールの音が 遠ざかる

[Chorus]
ああ 霧の波止場
帰らぬ船を 待つ男
煙草の火だけが 赤く燃えて
未練をそっと 照らしてる

[Instrumental Break - Saxophone Solo]

[Verse 3]
忘れてくれと 置き手紙
忘れられたら 苦労はしない
グラスの底に 沈めても
浮かんでくるのは お前だけ

[Chorus]
ああ 霧の波止場
帰らぬ船を 待つ男
夜明けの鴎が 鳴く頃に
ひとり背中を 向けてゆく

[Outro]

items.title: 歌舞路ブルース
items.caption: Late 1960s Japanese kayo blues, slow and sultry, a nightclub torch song. A smoky, husky female alto singing in Japanese, bitter and proud, with a slow vibrato at the ends of phrases. Muted trumpet with a wah mute, sobbing tenor saxophone, tremolo electric guitar, upright bass, brushed drums with a slow triplet feel, soft strings. Weary, defiant, a hostess taking off her make-up as the neon goes out. Warm vintage studio sound with plate reverb.
items.lyrics:
[Intro - Muted Trumpet]

[Verse 1]
ネオンが消える 午前四時
化粧を落とす 鏡の前
嘘をつくのも 仕事のうち
笑ってみせた 今夜も

[Chorus]
歌舞路ブルース 女の街
涙は見せない 意地がある
歌舞路ブルース 夜の花
咲いて散るのが さだめなら

[Verse 2]
あんたがくれた 安い指輪
質屋の窓に 光ってる
恨んでなんか いないけど
雨の夜には 思い出す

[Chorus]
歌舞路ブルース 女の街
涙は見せない 意地がある
歌舞路ブルース 夜の花
咲いて散るのが さだめなら

[Instrumental Break - Muted Trumpet Solo]

[Verse 3]
生まれた町は 北の果て
帰る切符は とうに捨てた
グラスを重ね 夢を売り
明日もここで 生きてゆく

[Chorus]
歌舞路ブルース 女の街
涙は見せない 意地がある
歌舞路ブルース 夜の花
誰かのために もう一度

[Outro]

items.title: The Last Cigarette
items.caption: 1950s torch song, a slow jazz ballad in the film noir style. A smoky, intimate female jazz singer in English, low and unhurried, close to the microphone, heartbroken but composed. Late-night piano, a lush string orchestra, soft upright bass, brushed drums, a lonely muted trumpet between the lines. Bittersweet, elegant, a woman alone in a nightclub after closing time. Warm vintage studio sound.
items.lyrics:
[Intro - Piano]

[Verse 1]
The band packed up an hour ago
The barman's stacking chairs
There's lipstick on an empty glass
And smoke still on the stairs

[Verse 2]
You said you'd only be a while
You said you'd be right back
I watched the door till closing time
And the rain turned the windows black

[Chorus]
So I'll smoke the last cigarette
And I'll let the last record play
I'll wear the dress that you loved best
And I'll walk home the long, long way
Don't ask me if I'm lonely
Don't ask me if I'm blue
I've got the last cigarette, darling
But I haven't got you

[Verse 3]
They say this town forgets a face
As quick as neon dies
But every stranger in the rain
Has you behind his eyes

[Chorus]
So I'll smoke the last cigarette
And I'll let the last record play
I'll wear the dress that you loved best
And I'll walk home the long, long way
Don't ask me if I'm lonely
Don't ask me if I'm blue
I've got the last cigarette, darling
But I haven't got you

[Instrumental Break - Piano Solo]

[Chorus]
Don't ask me if I'm lonely
Don't ask me if I'm blue
I've got the last cigarette, darling
But I haven't got you

[Outro]

items.title: Nobody Leaves Kaburo
items.caption: Slow, dark noir blues with a jazz band. A gravelly, weathered male baritone singing in English, half sung and half growled, like a man telling his story at the end of the bar. Prowling upright bass, a muted trumpet, twangy tremolo electric guitar, smoky tenor saxophone, slow swinging drums with brushes, a low piano. Shady, fatalistic, wry, a city of rain and neon that never lets anyone go. Warm, roomy, vintage club sound.
items.lyrics:
[Intro - Upright Bass and Muted Trumpet]

[Verse 1]
I came in on the night train with a suitcase and a name
Figured I'd be gone by Friday, well, the joke's on me again
The dragon on the rooftop, he's been watching all along
Brother, nobody leaves Kaburo once the neon sings its song

[Verse 2]
I owe a man some money and I owe a girl the truth
I left them both in an alley with the better part of my youth
The rain comes down like judgment and the gutters run with gin
Nobody leaves Kaburo, they just learn to live in sin

[Chorus]
Nobody leaves, nobody leaves
You can pack your bag, you can roll your sleeves
The last train's gone and the bridges are long
Nobody leaves Kaburo

[Verse 3]
There's a card game in the back room where the losers never fold
There's a cop who looks the other way for a little bit of gold
And a woman at the counter, she just pours and doesn't ask
Nobody leaves Kaburo, friend, we all just wear the mask

[Chorus]
Nobody leaves, nobody leaves
You can pack your bag, you can roll your sleeves
The last train's gone and the bridges are long
Nobody leaves Kaburo

[Instrumental Break - Muted Trumpet Solo]

[Chorus]
Nobody leaves, nobody leaves
You can pack your bag, you can roll your sleeves
The last train's gone and the bridges are long
Nobody leaves Kaburo

[Outro]
Nobody leaves
Nobody leaves

items.title: 午前二時のタンゴ
items.caption: 1960s Japanese kayo tango, dramatic and dangerous, film noir mood. A passionate, dark-toned female vocalist singing in Japanese with theatrical intensity and a strong vibrato. Stabbing tango rhythm from a bandoneon and piano, a weeping solo violin, upright bass, castanets and snare rolls, a string section swelling in the chorus. Seductive, bitter, a femme fatale dancing with the man who betrayed her. Vintage studio sound with plate reverb.
items.lyrics:
[Intro - Bandoneon and Violin]

[Verse 1]
赤い靴を はいた夜は
誰かを傷つけたくなるの
グラスの縁に 口紅のあと
あなたの嘘を 数えてる

[Chorus]
踊りましょう 午前二時のタンゴ
愛と憎しみ 紙一重
踊りましょう 最後のタンゴ
夜が明けたら 他人同士

[Verse 2]
薔薇の棘より 痛いのは
やさしい声の 裏切りね
知っていたのよ はじめから
それでも抱かれた 私の負け

[Chorus]
踊りましょう 午前二時のタンゴ
愛と憎しみ 紙一重
踊りましょう 最後のタンゴ
夜が明けたら 他人同士

[Instrumental Break - Bandoneon and Violin]

[Verse 3]
ハンドバッグの 奥底に
冷たい秘密 しのばせて
微笑みながら 腕の中
ステップ踏むの ナイフのように

[Chorus]
踊りましょう 午前二時のタンゴ
愛と憎しみ 紙一重
踊りましょう 最後のタンゴ
夜が明けたら 他人同士

[Outro]

items.title: 別れの最終電車
items.caption: 1960s Japanese mood kayo duet, slow and bittersweet. A deep male baritone crooner and a husky female alto trade lines in Japanese, then sing the chorus together in close harmony. Sobbing tenor saxophone, tremolo electric guitar, soft Latin-tinged brushed drums with a gentle beguine rhythm, upright bass, vibraphone, a quiet string section. Tender, resigned, two lovers parting on a station platform at night in the rain. Warm vintage studio sound with plate reverb.
items.lyrics:
[Intro - Saxophone]

[Verse 1 - Male]
時計の針が せかしてる
言えない言葉を 残したまま

[Verse 1 - Female]
ホームの端で うつむいて
私はベルを 待っている

[Chorus - Duet]
別れの最終電車
ドアが閉まれば それきりね
別れの最終電車
窓のしずくは 雨か涙か

[Verse 2 - Male]
幸せになれと 言いながら
本当は腕を 離せない

[Verse 2 - Female]
やさしい嘘は もういいの
あなたの背中 忘れない

[Chorus - Duet]
別れの最終電車
ドアが閉まれば それきりね
別れの最終電車
窓のしずくは 雨か涙か

[Instrumental Break - Saxophone Solo]

[Bridge - Duet]
もしもあの日に 戻れたら
同じ道を また歩く

[Chorus - Duet]
別れの最終電車
ドアが閉まれば それきりね
別れの最終電車
窓のしずくは 雨か涙か

[Outro]

items.title: Rain Check
items.caption: Spoken word over slow film noir jazz. A deep, weary male voice speaks, not sings, a hard-boiled detective's monologue in English, dry and unhurried, close to the microphone, with long pauses. Behind him a smoky tenor saxophone, soft brushed drums, a slow walking upright bass and sparse late-night piano chords, the hush of rain. Cynical, tired, a private eye alone in his office after midnight. Intimate vintage studio sound.
items.lyrics:
[Intro - Saxophone]

[Spoken Word]
It was raining the night she walked in.
It's always raining the night they walk in.
She had a photograph, an envelope, and a story.
The photograph was real. The envelope was thick.
The story had more holes than my umbrella.

[Spoken Word]
I took the case. I always take the case.
Rent's due on the first,
and the first doesn't care who's lying to who.

[Instrumental Break - Saxophone]

[Spoken Word]
Three days. Two bars. One black sedan,
parked where a black sedan had no business being.
A man in a good suit told me to forget her name.
I told him I was never good with names.
He wasn't good with jokes.

[Spoken Word]
By Thursday I knew where the husband was.
By Friday I knew why she never wanted him found.
In this town the truth is like the last train.
You either catch it, or you walk home in the rain.

[Instrumental Break - Piano]

[Spoken Word]
She paid me in cash and didn't count it.
I didn't count it either.
Some things you'd rather not know the price of.

[Spoken Word]
The rain stopped around four.
It'll be back.
It always comes back.

[Outro - Saxophone]

items.title: 雨のカウンター
items.caption: Slow, dark bossa nova ballad with a noir mood, sung in Japanese. A soft, whispery female voice, cool and melancholy, almost murmuring into the microphone. Nylon-string guitar playing a gentle bossa rhythm, upright bass, brushes and soft rim clicks, a breathy alto flute, quiet vibraphone, late-night piano fills. Lonely, quiet, a woman alone at a bar counter while it rains outside. Intimate, warm, vintage studio sound.
items.lyrics:
[Intro - Guitar]

[Verse 1]
雨の音を 聞きながら
グラスの氷 まわしてる
隣の席は 空いたまま
あなたの好きな 曲が流れる

[Chorus]
雨のカウンター ひとりきり
マスターは何も 聞かないわ
雨のカウンター もう一杯
酔えない夜も あるものね

[Verse 2]
マッチの箱に 書いた番号
にじんで読めなく なってゆく
忘れることが 上手になって
大人になった つもりでいたの

[Chorus]
雨のカウンター ひとりきり
マスターは何も 聞かないわ
雨のカウンター もう一杯
酔えない夜も あるものね

[Instrumental Break - Guitar and Flute]

[Verse 3]
傘を持たずに 出てきたの
濡れて帰るわ 今夜は
さよならよりも 静かなものが
この世にあると 知ったから

[Chorus]
雨のカウンター ひとりきり
マスターは何も 聞かないわ
雨のカウンター もう一杯
酔えない夜も あるものね

[Outro]

items.title: Blue Neon, Black Coffee
items.caption: 1950s cool jazz vocal with a noir mood, easy medium swing. A smoky, knowing female jazz singer in English, relaxed and behind the beat, dry wit in her voice. Walking upright bass, light swinging ride cymbal and brushes, shimmering vibraphone, hollow-body jazz guitar comping, a cool muted trumpet answering the vocal. Sleepless, wry, a woman alone in an all-night diner at three in the morning. Warm vintage club sound.
items.lyrics:
[Intro - Vibraphone]

[Verse 1]
Blue neon, black coffee, quarter past three
A booth in the corner, my shadow and me
The jukebox is playing a tune I don't know
And I've got no reason, no reason to go

[Verse 2]
The waitress is yawning, the cook's half asleep
A cop at the counter with secrets to keep
The rain on the window is tapping in time
Blue neon, black coffee, and nothing is mine

[Bridge]
Somewhere there's a morning with sun on the sheets
Somewhere there's a fella who means what he speaks
But I know this city, and I know this town
The sun only rises to let a girl down

[Verse 3]
So pour me another, and leave me the cream
I'll sit here till daylight and finish my dream
Blue neon, black coffee, quarter to four
I'll leave when the night doesn't love me no more

[Instrumental Break - Vibraphone Solo]

[Bridge]
Somewhere there's a morning with sun on the sheets
Somewhere there's a fella who means what he speaks
But I know this city, and I know this town
The sun only rises to let a girl down

[Verse 3]
So pour me another, and leave me the cream
I'll sit here till daylight and finish my dream
Blue neon, black coffee, quarter to four
I'll leave when the night doesn't love me no more

[Outro]

items.title: 義理の雨
items.caption: Dark 1960s Japanese enka ballad in the yakuza film style, slow and heavy. A deep, rough male voice singing in Japanese with strong enka vibrato and ornamented phrase endings, stoic and sorrowful. Mournful shakuhachi bamboo flute, a twangy electric guitar playing the melody between lines, low strings, upright bass, slow drums with a heavy backbeat, a distant taiko. Grim, dignified, a gangster walking alone in the rain toward a debt of honour. Vintage studio sound with plate reverb.
items.lyrics:
[Intro - Shakuhachi and Guitar]

[Verse 1]
杯ひとつ 交わした夜に
捨てた故郷と 親の名前
筋を通して 生きると決めた
戻る道など ありゃしない

[Chorus]
雨よ降れ降れ 背中に降れ
肩の刺青を 濡らして降れ
誰が泣こうと 引くに引けない
これが俺の 生きる道

[Verse 2]
惚れた女に 別れも告げず
路地の灯りを 背にして歩く
幸せなんて 似合わぬ男
忘れてくれと 風に言う

[Chorus]
雨よ降れ降れ 背中に降れ
肩の刺青を 濡らして降れ
誰が泣こうと 引くに引けない
これが俺の 生きる道

[Instrumental Break - Shakuhachi and Guitar]

[Verse 3]
受けた恩には 命で返す
散るも咲くも 花のさだめ
夜明けの橋で 見上げた空に
おふくろの顔が 浮かんで消える

[Chorus]
雨よ降れ降れ 背中に降れ
肩の刺青を 濡らして降れ
誰が泣こうと 引くに引けない
これが俺の 生きる道

[Outro]
